itemGroup.dragonsteel_schools: Ice and Fire: Schools of Dragonsteel
jei.dragonsteel_schools.blood.how: Pour Dragon's Breath into a cauldron, a bottle per level. Look at it and cast any %s spell within %s blocks, then fill glass bottles from it.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.finishing.apex.t: On the Apex list: it finishes steel under either rule
jei.dragonsteel_schools.finishing.disabl: Not on this server: it runs the Apex Only add-on, so only Apex spells finish steel.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.finishing.how: Look at a dragon forge holding the tempered steel and cast it, within %s blocks. One cast finishes up to %s.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.finishing.legend: Iron's Spells rates it Legendary from level %s (of %s)
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.armor: Each piece gives +%1$s max mana, +%2$s%% spell power and +%3$s%% %4$s spell power.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.blood: Brewing: pour Dragon's Breath into an empty cauldron, one bottle per level, up to three. Look at the cauldron and cast any %1$s spell from within %2$s blocks. The breath becomes %1$s Dragon Blood; fill glass bottles from it.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.blood.uses: Uses: with iron ingots in an Ice and Fire dragon forge it tempers %1$s steel. With Ice and Fire: Spellbooks' Dragon Priest Staff it makes the %1$s staff.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.briar: The poison and slowness land on every hit.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.covenant: The fangs rise in a line from you toward the foe.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.dawn: +%1$s damage against undead. Each hit sets the target alight with holy fire for %2$s s: %3$s damage a second, %4$s times that on undead. Water does not put it out; milk does.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.dragon_brea: Schools of Dragonsteel: pour Dragon's Breath into a cauldron, one bottle per level, then cast a spell at it to brew that school's dragon blood. Holy, Ender, Blood, Evocation, Nature and Eldritch spells work; Fire, Ice and Lightning do not.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.elsewhere: While you hold it, arrows and spell projectiles that would hit you miss: you step aside, up to %s blocks, like an enderman. Melee and beams still land.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.elsewhere.a: While you hold it, arrows that would hit you miss: you step aside, up to %s blocks, like an enderman. Spells, melee and beams still land.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.elsewhere.c: After each dodge it rests for %s s.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.elsewhere.m: Works from the main hand only.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.hush: Players struck are wrapped in Darkness.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.ingot: %1$s Dragonsteel: finished from tempered %1$s steel at a dragon forge. It makes the %1$s dragonsteel armour, %2$s and the four tools.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.staff: Made in a dragon forge from Ice and Fire: Spellbooks' Dragon Priest Staff and %s Dragon Blood, the way Spellbooks makes its own element staves. Needs Ice and Fire: Spellbooks.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.tempered: The dragon's part: put iron ingots and %1$s Dragon Blood in an Ice and Fire dragon forge of any kind (fire, ice or lightning). While a dragon breathes into the forge it tempers one ingot every 50 seconds, the pace of Ice and Fire's own dragonsteel.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.tempered.ap: On a server running the Apex Only add-on, only Apex spells finish the steel.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.tempered.fi: The spell's part: look at the forge and cast a %1$s spell of Legendary rarity, or a %1$s Apex spell. Every piece of tempered %1$s steel in the forge, up to %2$s, becomes %1$s Dragonsteel. Look at the forge when the cast begins or when it ends, from within %3$s blocks. The Dragonsteel Finishing pages list the spells that work.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.thirst: Only the sword's own hits count, sweeps included; spells do not.
jei.dragonsteel_schools.info.tools: %s dragonsteel tools: the same tier as Ice and Fire's dragonsteel (mining level 4, 8,000 uses, mining speed 10).
